findings.label: Nonce replay logic inverted
findings.description: checkAndMarkNonceUsed returns true on first use (allow) and false on replay (reject), but lti.ts line 171 checks `if (!nonceUsed)` to reject, which rejects valid launches and allows replays. Swap the condition to `if (nonceUsed === false)` or negate the variable name.

findings.label: Optional repository methods may fail silently
findings.description: checkAndMarkTokenReplayed, checkAndMarkNonceUsed, deleteLtiState, getLtiStateAndNonce are called via optional chaining that silently skips if not implemented. If repo doesn't implement them (e.g., test harness), nonce/state/token checks are bypassed entirely. Make these mandatory or add explicit fallback to Set-based store.

findings.label: OpenAPI YAML does not render LTI routes
findings.description: Code registers three LTI paths in openapi.ts (lines 795–898) but built openapi.yaml shows zero matches for '/lti'. Verify build step and ensure registry is exported to YAML or regenerate file.

findings.label: State storage does not verify expiry on retrieval
findings.description: getLtiStateAndNonce retrieves state from DB but does not check expiry timestamp on the returned row. Add explicit expiry check after retrieval: `if (now > stateData.expiresAt) { reject }`
